CustomField.formula: IF( OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Open"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Followed Up") ), IF(TODAY() - EffectiveDate <= 3, "Open", "Expired"), CASE( TEXT(Status__c), "Closed", "Expired", "In Process", "In Process", "Shipping", "In Process", "Printed", "In Process", "Order Received", "Order Received", "Entered", "Order Received", "Invoiced", "Invoiced", "Cancelled", "Cancelled", "-" ) )
CustomField.label: E-Commerce Status
